The Foster County Auditor is an appointed position and combined with the Treasurer's Office. The current Foster County Auditor/Treasurer is Ellen Roundy.
The Auditor performs the following duties:
Act as clerk of the Board of County Commissioners and keep an accurate recording of the official proceedings of the Board.
Prepare a financial statement of the county annually, unless otherwise ordered by the Board of County Commissioners.
Upon receiving any document, bond, or other paper required to be filed in the auditor's office, number and index the same and make the proper entries in the reception book.
Carefully preserve all documents, books, records, maps, and other papers required to be deposited or kept in the auditor's office.
File and preserve in the auditor's office all accounts, vouchers, and other papers pertaining to the settlement of any and all accounts to which the county is a part and copy such papers certified with the hand and seal of the auditor shall be admitted as evidence in all courts in the state.
Perform all acts required of the auditor relative to the making out and delivering of notices of general and special elections, making abstract of and canvassing the votes cast in elections, issuing certificates of election, and forwarding the abstract of votes cast to the Secretary of State.
Do and perform all acts not enumerated in this section which the auditor is required to do by law ( see Chapter 11-13: County Auditor )
Serves the county as the IT Coordnator, Risk Manager and Human Resources.
Maintains the website
